claude.sample_unit: CDSS outputs scored by AI raters

links.outcome: AI rater scoring discrimination under rubric-anchored (Gold Rubric) vs rubric-free protocol
links.effect: Non-GR scores 74–78 on average, 7.69 to 49.64 points higher than GR; GR amplified discrimination between DRG and Baseline outputs by factors of 1.76 to 5.10.
links.quote: Within each question, GR amplified the AI rater's discrimination between DRG and Baseline CDSS outputs by factors of 1.76 to 5.10, while also revealing substantial behavioral variation across rater models that Non-GR suppressed.
